meta.name: ship
meta.description: Verify and publish changes — push, open PR, watch CI until green; land mode merges an existing PR and cleans up. Triggers "ship it", "create PR", "open PR", "ready to merge", "/pr", "/ship", "push and PR", "watch the PR", "babysit CI", "loop until green"; land mode "land it", "/ship land", "fix CI and merge", "merge it then clean the branches", "merge and clean up".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 一键创建 PR，自动监视 CI 直至合并
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常需要发起 PR 并等到 CI 通过后合并代码。
copy.tagline_en: Create PR, watch CI, and merge in one command.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to open a PR and wait for CI to pass before merging.

howto.what: Claude会自动执行代码验证和发布流程：进行类型检查、构建、测试、lint、代码审查、提交、推送、创建PR并监控CI通过；对于已有PR，执行合并和清理。
howto.when: 当用户说出“ship it”、“create PR”、“open PR”等触发词，或要求land模式（如“land it”、“/ship land”）时触发。

say.note: 推送当前分支并创建Pull Request

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will automatically execute a code verification and publishing pipeline: type check, build, test, lint, code review, commit, push, create PR, and watch CI until green. For existing PRs, it will merge and clean up branches.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user says "ship it", "create PR", "open PR", etc., or requests land mode like "land it", "/ship land".

say_en.note: Push current branch and create a Pull Request
Monitor CI status of the PR until all checks pass
